died.name: Saladin
died.desc: first sultan of Egypt and Syria
died.last_words: When I am buried, carry my winding-sheet on the point of a spear, and say these words: Behold the spoils which Saladin carries with him! Of all his victories, realms, and riches, nothing remains to him but this.

died.name: Nikolai Gogol
died.last_words: Give me! Give me! Come on, give me! The ladder! Quick, pass me the ladder!

died.name: Thomas Starr King
died.desc: American Universalist and Unitarian minister and orator
died.cause: when his young son was brought to see him
died.last_words: Dear little fellow-he is a beautiful boy.

died.name: Amos Bronson Alcott
died.desc: American teacher, writer, philosopher and reformer
died.cause: to his daughter, Louisa May Alcott
died.last_words: I am going up. Come with me.

died.name: Archibald Anderson
died.cause: The 19-year-old was bathing in the Yarra River when a tooth plate fell out and got lodged in his throat, choking him to death.

died.name: Leonard Warren
died.cause: performing in La Forza del Destino at the Metropolitan Opera before dying on stage
died.last_words: He is safe! He is safe! Oh, joy!

died.name: Hank Gathers
died.last_words: I don't want to lay down.

born.name: Jack Sheppard
born.last_words: I have ever cherished an honest pride; never have I stooped to friendship with Jonathan Wild, or with any of his detestable thief-takers; and though an undutiful son, I never damned my mother's eyes.

born.name: Robert Emmet
born.desc: Irish Republican and Irish nationalist patriot, orator and rebel leader
born.cause: during execution by hanging for treason. The executioner carried out the hanging in the middle of Emmet's attempt to say "Not yet" for the third time

born.name: William Price
born.last_words: Bring me a glass of Champagne.

born.name: Gustav Kobbé
born.cause: The 61-year-old author and music critic was sailing in Great South Bay, New York, when he noticed a low-flying seaplane heading toward him. Kobbé attempted to get into the water, but the plane crashed into the mast of Kobbé's boat, splitting his head open.
